newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia MICEX cancels some afternoon T-bill trades - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: Russia MICEX cancels some afternoon T-bill trades - Nov 6.

text.p: The Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange annulled results of Wednesday's government paper trading from 3.50 p.m. to 4.24 p.m. (1250-1324 GMT) because of a technical fault in the trading system, a MICEX official said.
Deputy chief executive Alexander Sarchev told Reuters a new session would be held from 5.50 p.m. to 6.30 p.m.
Earlier MICEX suspended trading after the system broke down.
"There is a suspicion that it happened because trading was held on the day of the auctions," he said. "It is a novelty for the programme."
The central bank said this morning it would hold government paper trading today after the Treasury bills auctions.

Normally there is no secondary market trading on days when auctions are held -- usually Wednesdays. But markets will be closed on Thursday and Friday this week for holidays marking the anniversary of the 1917 revolution.
